messages.content: You extract structured order data from customer support emails. Reply with a single JSON object that validates against the JSON schema given in the user message. Use null for any field the email does not explicitly state; never guess or infer. Write dates as YYYY-MM-DD, currencies as ISO 4217 codes, and amounts as plain numbers with a dot as the decimal separator. Keep names exactly as written. The email may be in any language. Do not wrap the JSON in markdown and do not add any commentary. If the currency is not mentioned in the email, you must output null for the currency field. Extract the order_id only from the email body or subject; do not fabricate it. The customer_email is the sender's email address ONLY when the sender is the customer placing the order; if the sender is a support agent or a different person, output null. The customer_name must be the full name of the customer as written in the email body or signature; do not use the From header name unless it matches the customer identity. The order_date is the date the order was placed, not the email date; if not stated, output null. Do not mix information from different orders mentioned in the email; each field must come from the same order context.

JSON schema:
{"properties": {"order_id": {"anyOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "description": "Order id such as HH-48213, null if not stated", "title": "Order Id"}, "customer_name": {"anyOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "description": "Full name of the customer as written", "title": "Customer Name"}, "customer_email": {"anyOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "description": "Customer's email address", "title": "Customer Email"}, "order_date": {"anyOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "description": "Order date as YYYY-MM-DD, null if not stated", "title": "Order Date"}, "total_amount": {"anyOf": [{"type": "number"}, {"type": "null"}], "description": "Order total as a plain number, no symbol", "title": "Total Amount"}, "currency": {"anyOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "description": "ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. EUR", "title": "Currency"}, "issue": {"enum": ["damaged", "missing_item", "wrong_item", "late_delivery", "billing_error", "other"], "title": "Issue", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["order_id", "customer_name", "customer_email", "order_date", "total_amount", "currency", "issue"], "title": "OrderFields", "type": "object"}

Email:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@example.uk>
To: support@helphub.example
Date: Mon, 5 May 2025 09:15:00 +0000
Subject: Query regarding order HH-06707

Dear Support Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to bring to your attention a concern I have regarding my recent purchase. I placed order HH-06707 on your website several weeks ago for a set of premium kitchen utensils, which included a stainless steel spatula, a silicone whisk, and a ceramic mixing bowl. The items were dispatched promptly and arrived in good condition, for which I am grateful.

However, upon reviewing my bank statement, I noticed that the total amount charged was 405.27 GBP, which appears to be incorrect based on the pricing displayed at the time of checkout. I have double-checked the order confirmation email and the product pages, and the discrepancy remains unexplained.

Could you kindly investigate this billing error and advise on the next steps? I would appreciate either a correction to the charge or a detailed explanation of the fees applied.

Thank you for your time and assistance.

Best regards,
Liam O'Connor
